lines: composer/autoload.php is there, but autoload.psr-4 of composer.json does not map OCA\Viewer\ to lib/. With a Composer autoloader the server registers no loader of its own for the classes of the app.
The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.
